report.candidate_letter:
Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Data Scientist position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show the following required points: good knowledge of probability theory and statistics, understanding of Bayesian methods or time series analysis, hands-on experience with probabilistic programming (Pyro, PyMC3, JAGS, or similar), experience with Amazon SageMaker, experience with PySpark, or strong working knowledge of SQL.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
